title: Personnel of the Onward Brass Band
summary: Williams names Onward's trumpets, trombones and others while he played with it, but cannot recall the sousaphone player.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh. Who were the three tracks with the Arnold one? I couldn't get that.

That's the Arnold man. When I was playing with him. Mm-hmm. When I was playing with him, there were Maurice, Manuel Perez, and that sometime Rick. Mm-hmm. And sometime another trumpet player. Uh-huh. But Maurice and Manuel was the main trumpet players. Mm-hmm. And, uh, Eddie Yank on trombone. Yank Johnson on trombone. And Piku played with us. Uh-huh. And sometime Eddie Sherry playing that. Had old man Tatt baritone. Mm-hmm. And who else was playing trombone with the Ancret to trombone? Well, I'm afraid. I never even get that from him. I'm afraid.
I'm afraid. Mm-hmm. What about, uh, sousaphone?
I never even get that from him. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
I'm sorry. Mr. Garrett? You over there?
Yeah. He had a clean suit for going with us. I'm leaving Best Pete back. I can't remember. We had one, but I can't remember. That's Pete. He can tell.
